summary: Focused retest of iter73 fixes. PASS: sanitizer (unclosed escaped to <img, 10 bypass variants neutralised), upload email validation (422 'Bitte eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse angeben'), valid email stored lowercased + returned in admin submissions + visible in UI (du-sub-email-), admin_email_sent true, admin contract dialog new copy + red warning when customer_email_sent false, smoke of /, /formular, /dokument-upload, /register, /admin, /dashboard/uebersicht (tester, 300 EUR intact) without page errors. FAIL: (1) user delete cascade leaves watchlist rows (code deletes 'watchlist_items' but collection is 'watchlists'); (2) IP rate limit still spoofable live: 12 failed /api/formular-access/verify with random X-Forwarded-For -> all 401, never 429; fail_log stored the spoofed 198.51.100.x values. No CF-Connecting-IP/X-Real-IP reaches the backend in preview (client-sent CF-Connecting-IP is blocked with 403 by Cloudflare; client X-Real-IP is ignored), so the code falls back to the client-controlled first XFF entry.

critical.endpoint: POST /api/formular-access/verify (+ any limiter keyed on routes.formular_access._client_ip / server._client_ip)
critical.issue: Brute-force limit can be bypassed: a random first X-Forwarded-For entry per request gives a new bucket. Live: 12/12 -> 401, no 429. CF-Connecting-IP/X-Real-IP are not present behind the preview ingress, so the code always falls back to xff.split(',')[0], which the client controls. Fix: use the right-most XFF entry (the one the ingress appends, as server.py:1771 already does) or the right-most entry that is not a trusted proxy. Only trust CF-Connecting-IP when the request really came through Cloudflare.

Watchlist rows are left behind: admin_users.py:235 deletes 'watchlist_items', but the app uses db.watchlists (server.py:3897, portfolio.py:738). Live: before {watchlists:1}, after {watchlists:1}. cash_ledger, depot_contracts, stock_positions, bond_positions and payout_requests were correctly removed. 'user_sessions' is also not used anywhere.

minor.issue: Other per-user collections are not cleaned up: stock_alerts, stock_alert_notifications, order_executions, position_adjustments, order_notifications.
These still each have their own XFF-first IP logic and do not use the shared _client_ip, so the same spoofing works on submission, upload, login and application rate limits.

ui_bugs.issue: The form summary block never renders: the code reads selected.form_summary, but GET /api/admin/contract-form-submissions returns 'summary'. A seeded summary {Betrag, Laufzeit} did not appear. selected.admin_resend_id is also never returned.

issues: The visitor welcome / cookie gate (data-testid=visitor-welcome-gate) also covers admin pages for logged-in admins without consent stored in localStorage, and blocks clicks.

action_items: admin_users.admin_delete_user: replace 'watchlist_items' with 'watchlists'; drop 'user_sessions'; also delete stock_alerts, stock_alert_notifications, order_executions, position_adjustments, order_notifications

_client_ip (formular_access + server): do not trust the left-most XFF entry; use the right-most one the ingress appends (or the right-most untrusted hop). Make the upload/contract/auth/applications/assistant rate limiters use this one shared helper
AdminContractSubmissions.js: read selected.summary (or map summary -> form_summary)
Do not show the visitor gate on /admin routes
critical_code_review_comments: Sanitizer in _summary_html is now OK (allow-list, attributes stripped, everything else escaped). Still regex-based; consider bleach/nh3 for robustness
IP logic is copied in about 7 places (DRY); keep a single helper

success_rate.frontend: 90% (copy, warning, email column and smoke OK; summary block missing)

seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ contract submission and doc-upload submission (fixed ids, via seed_iter74_ui.py), an audit+<rand>@example.com user with assets, and a TEST_iter74 upload code. All removed; formular_access_fail_log test entries deleted. tester@mester.de cash 300 EUR untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest -n0 /app/backend/tests/test_iter74_fixes.py. Unit tests need dotenv and must import server before routes.formular_access (circular import). TestLiveIpRateLimit::test_random_cf_connecting_ip_bypass always gets 403 from Cloudflare, so treat it as informational (not a real failure); delete formular_access_fail_log rows for 198.51.100.*/203.0.113.*/34.7.135.173 afterwards. To get past the visitor gate in Playwright, set localStorage kapitalmitte_cookie_consent + kapitalmitte_visitor_profile.
rca of the issue: XFF: the preview ingress appends the real IP to the client-supplied XFF and sets no CF-Connecting-IP/X-Real-IP, so xff[0] is attacker-controlled. Orphan watchlist: wrong collection name in the cascade list.
